confirm.title: Restart Home Assistant
confirm.description:
The dashboard needs vtherm_api {required} or later, but version {running} is still running. The new version is installed but only loaded when Home Assistant restarts.

Select Submit to restart Home Assistant now. The dashboard will then start normally.
